title: Kiewa, VIC - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned network upgrades are scheduled in Kiewa, VIC, and may interrupt Fixed Wireless internet services. Up to three planned service interruptions, each lasting up to 8 hours, may occur between Tuesday 15 September and Thursday 17 September during the broader maintenance window, which runs until Saturday 19 September at 5:00 PM AEST. Customers are encouraged to plan ahead and consider using mobile data during the interruptions. Our team will keep monitoring and provide updates if the schedule changes.

updates.content:
We’re notifying customers in Kiewa, VIC of planned Fixed Wireless network upgrades by one of our upstream providers. During this work, some services may lose connection.

Planned interruptions:
- Tue 15 Sep, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM AEST (up to 4 hours)
- Wed 16 Sep, 8:00 AM–12:00 PM AEST (up to 4 hours)

The overall maintenance window runs until Sat 19 Sep, 5:00 PM AEST and timings may move within this window. If possible, please plan ahead for any critical activities and consider using mobile data as a backup during the interruptions. We’ll keep monitoring and will update you if the schedule changes. Thank you for your patience.

The planned maintenance works in Kiewa, VIC have been updated. There are now up to three potential service interruptions, each of up to 8 hours, which may occur on separate days between Tuesday 15 September and Thursday 17 September within the current maintenance window. The overall maintenance window remains scheduled until Saturday 19 September at 5:00 PM AEST. Please plan accordingly and consider using mobile data during the possible interruptions. We will continue to monitor and provide any further updates as needed.
